name: yt-flywheel-team
description: YouTube Evergreen Flywheel — 13-skill AI Agent Team with two-tier orchestration and context-block handoff. Strategic Launch Orchestrator defines the playlist concept, delegates funnel building to the email-list-building plugin, and stores the permanent opt-in URL. Video Production Orchestrator runs the per-video pipeline (SEO, script, audio, thumbnail, publish). Post-publish: Shorts, repurposing+community, 25-language captions, conversion audit. Multi-channel, outputs in Google Drive.
